notes.title: Update - Demo Build v0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Demo build v0.2 is live![/h1]
This update contains a decent amount of changes, which I'll do my best to outline below. As always, feedback encouraged! There's a feedback button in the game menu which links to a Google form. Feel free to post in the community hub as well. Bug reporting is also much appreciated!

[h2]Changes:[/h2]

[h3]Settlers[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added settler stats: [u]Efficiency[/u], [u]Immunity[/u], and [u]Devotion[/u].
[*]Added daily resource needs: [u]Food[/u], [u]Medicine[/u], and [u]Influence[/u]
[*]Added conditions: [u]Hunger[/u], [u]Health[/u], and [u]Devotion[/u]
[*]Added [u]Diseases[/u], which can be contracted by settlers with low [u]Health[/u]
[*]Added the [u]Coup[/u] event, which is started by settlers with low [u]Devotion[/u]
[*]Removed settler [u]Happiness[/u]
[/list]

[h3]Resources[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [u]Medicine[/u] resources, which are consumed to keep settler [u]Health[/u] high
[*][u]Trees[/u] now regrow
[*][u]Flax[/u] now regrows
[*]Some [u]Medicine[/u] resources regrow
[*]Resource spawn rates changed
[/list]

[h3]Structures[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [u]Wood Bridge[/u]
[*]Added [u]Mushroom Cellar[/u]
[*]Added [u]Purple Mushroom Cellar[/u]
[*]Added [u]Jammery[/u]
[*]Removed [u]Kitchen[/u]
[*][u]Gardening Shed[/u] now must be placed on existing [u]Fertile Soil[/u]
[*][u]Explorer Tent[/u] area reduced; auto-packs when area clear
[*]Reworked [u]Tavern[/u] and [u]Town Hall[/u]
[*]Many structure build requirements changed
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*][u]Winter[/u] now prevents many resources from growing
[*]Month length shortened to 25 days
[*][u]Harvest[/u] structures now highlight resources in range
[*]Added [u]Info Hover[/u] to resources
[*]Added [u]Info Tooltip[/u] when building
[/list]

notes.title: Add Settlement Stats, Controls Display, and Menu Button
notes.content:
There's a new menu in the top right with 3 buttons, which activate the following:

[list]
[*] New stats display, which shows some lifetime settlement stats such as total influence, resources collected, etc.
[*] Controls display, can now be accessed whenever
[*] Save/load/settings menu can now be opened with a button instead of only by pressing esc
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Audio settings now save and do not need to be readjusted between game launches
[*] Town hall and tavern won't show destroy notification if they have housing in their areas
[*] Exploring settlers can become lost and trapped in the fog. They will now respawn the next day at the settler's tent
[*] Stopped gold spawning as it's not harvestable yet
[*] Remove incorrect new structure notifications on load
[*] Fixed some bugs around settler auto-work
[/list]

notes.title: Add Settler Auto-work
notes.content:
This is a fairly large (although simple) change, as it affects the gameplay somewhat significantly. 

Before, settlers would only work at their assigned work structure. Now, work assignment is more of a priority assignment. Settlers will still perform work wherever they are assigned, but when they finish, if they still have energy, they will go to the nearest work structure and help out there.

This change reduces the amount of annoying micro-management of settlers previously needed to maximize their energy output. I think it makes the game much more fun and focuses on building, build order, and smart priority assignment instead of micro-ing settlers between different structures.

Additionally, settlers will start work right when spawned (provided work is available), without needing to assign them somewhere first. Instead of dumbly standing still, they will now dumbly go to the closest available work and help out.

notes.title: Ore Info Tip and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add tip about smelting ore with furnace when ore discovered
[*] Fix unclearable new structure notifications being loaded after save
[*] Fix wood resource menu being visible upon new game start
[/list]

notes.title: Gardening Shed Now Produces Both Flax and Wheat, Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Gardening shed now has a 50% chance to grow flax and a 50% chance to grow wheat
[*] Gardening shed build cost changed
[*] Added a feedback button to main menu and esc menu which links to a Google form
[*] Fix some small resource menu bugs
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed explorer's tent not updating resource pool when blockers are removed
[*] Fixed placement of new structure notification icons
[*] Fixed new structure notifications not saving
[*] Settlers will now only "go inside" after working hours
[/list]

notes.title: Add Production/Harvesting Building Tabs and Quarry Structure
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Separated building production tab into two separate tabs: harvesting and production. Harvesting structures simply "harvest" the existing resources around them, while production structures can "produce" new ones.
[*] Added a new structure, the quarry, which can "produce" stone.
[/list]

notes.title: Increase Flax Spawn Rate
notes.content: Many players have noted that fiber is often very limited, and can halt their progress. For now, I'll simply increasing the spawn rate of flax so players don't get stuck in a single area.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Two bugs patched, the first of which was reported by multiple players:

[list]
[*] Fix crash on settler recruitment when player had previously destroyed a housing structure
[*] Fix crash when building new housing after immediate in-game load
[/list]

notes.title: Settler's Domain Playtest is Live!
notes.content:
The first iteration of testing has begun! This is an exciting time as the game has only ever been tested by a small pool of people (so there are likely many bugs). The game is in a basic state, but is playable and needs feedback as well as bug reporting. I'll be giving players access incrementally, with total numbers depending on how many sign up.

Feedback is extremely important! Here is a quick Google form where I'll be collecting general feedback about the playtest: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfAC4PIHnRunKwxreMTnQ1XgAAEv7yyHoe_4mANkfYktFZ0Ig/viewform?usp=sharing]Settler's Domain Playtest General Feedback[/url]

If you encounter a bug, instead please send a screenshot and/or description to this email: settlersdomaingame@gmail.com


I appreciate any feedback, and thanks so much for wishlisting and participating in the playtest!
